name: w5b_two_models_interleaved
description: Two agents pinned to different models (0.5b and 7b) running concurrently. With OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1 (or two models whose combined VRAM exceeds the GPU) every alternation forces an unload+load; under contention the small agent pays the large model's load cost on every one of its turns and vice versa. Compare to w5a (sequential): w5a amortises the load over consecutive same-model requests; w5b never gets that chance. The small-model agent's TTFT is the headline: it should go from ~40 ms (w0) to seconds per request. GPU sidecar samples show the VRAM used dropping to zero briefly on every swap.
